messages:
alice: FYI i'm seeing a small uptick in TLS validation failures in eu-west and ap-south. error is 'session ticket HMAC mismatch' occasionally paired with KMS DecryptDenied. anyone aware of an IAM change or key rotation last night? :thinking:

maria: we did run an rbacsweep at 01:45Z to remove stale service account bindings. i thought the rotator SA was on the allowlist, but i'll double-check.

kevin: grabbing a log snippet now.

alice: paste below — one of the proxy hosts: 
```
2026-03-22T01:58:03Z proxy-ap-south-1 tls: session ticket HMAC mismatch id=0x2c1f
2026-03-22T01:58:03Z proxy-ap-south-1 kms: DecryptDenied key=projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/rotator/cryptoKeys/rotator-key
```

logan: interesting — rotator rotated to key v9 at 01:50Z per rotator logs. older tickets are signed with v8. proxies should be able to validate locally but we added a KMS fallback when cache misses occur.

kevin: looking at KMS audit: a flurry of 403s from `serviceAccount:rotator@redwood-prod` at 01:50:3001:51:10Z. so either rotator lost decrypt permission or we're seeing a mis-signed ticket.

maria: my RBAC prune may have removed `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` from rotator in an attempt to reduce blast radius — it was scoped to a wider group previously. i'm pretty sure i touched a binding that affected service accounts.

alice: that would explain it. timeline: rotator did the rotation -> proxies still had v8 tickets -> cache missed -> proxies called KMS to verify -> KMS denied -> handshake failed. can we re-add the role ASAP?

ops-oncall: I'd prefer we do a quick mitigation that preserves security: 1) re-grant kms:Decrypt to rotator SA for a short LIE (least-privilege exception) 2) increase ticket cache TTL to reduce KMS calls 3) add a prune-test to ensure future RBAC sweeps don't remove required perms.

maria: agreed. i'll open a short-lived exception and update the RBAC job to ignore `rotator` SA. will add tests.

logan: re-granted `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` to rotator SA and submitted infra PR #4682 with IAM diff: `+ bindings: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter -> serviceAccount:rotator@redwood-prod`.

kevin: pushed a ticket cache TTL bump to canary (`TICKET_CACHE_TTL=10m -> 40m`) to reduce KMS fallback frequency. also enabled additional logging for ticket-origin so we can see v8 vs v9 traffic.

rotator-bot: Rotation event recorded: rotator-key v9 deployed 2026-03-22T01:50Z. Fallback validation uses local cache then KMS unwrap.

alice: good. create an alert for higher-than-normal session ticket HMAC mismatch rates: threshold 0.1% over 15m. page oncall if exceeded.

ops-oncall: alert created: `session_ticket.hmac_mismatch_rate > 0.001 for 15m` -> page oncall.

maria: i'll follow up with a postmortem style note in the rotator docs and add a CI gate to the RBAC prune that verifies critical SAs still have required roles. will schedule with identity team.

logan: monitoring shows errors falling back to baseline ~25m after the fix. i'll keep an eye for anomalous reoccurrence.

alice: thanks everyone. action items: maria to file RBAC test and exception, logan to keep monitor up for 60m, kevin to run e2e canary for handshake acceptance, ops to keep the incident open for 2 hours.

kevin: e2e canary passed at +35m. proxy accepts legacy v8 tickets successfully.

rotator-bot: Incident INC-2026-82 opened and assigned to maria, ops-oncall, and logan. playbook link: https://handbook.redwood/mtls-rotator-fallback-playbook

alice: closing thread here, will file a short blameless postmortem once the RBAC test merges. :lock: :white_check_mark:
